name: North Carolina Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services
source_citation: NC Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services Strategic Plan 2025-2029
mission: Promotes agriculture and agribusiness and protects consumers through food safety and plant and animal health.

goals.title: Agricultural services
goals.citation: NC Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services Strategic Plan 2025-2029, p. 5
goals.description: Provide services to promote and enhance the production, marketing, and distribution of safe and healthy agricultural products.
objectives: 1.1 Increase the number of acres of land protected with long-term conservation easements and agreements
1.2 Increase and enhance the production and marketing of North Carolina agricultural products

goals.title: NC Forest Service
goals.citation: NC Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services Strategic Plan 2025-2029, p. 9
goals.description: Protect, manage and promote forest resources for the citizens of North Carolina.
objectives: 2.1 Increase the protection of the state's forests from the threat of wildfire
2.2 Increase the management of forest resources
2.3 Increase the promotion of forest resources

goals.title: Regulatory programs
goals.citation: NC Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services Strategic Plan 2025-2029, p. 14
goals.description: Protect public health, safety and welfare through food safety initiatives and by monitoring, protecting and maintaining animal and plant health.
objectives: 3.1 Improve complaint investigation and response time

goals.title: Enterprise centers
goals.citation: NC Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services Strategic Plan 2025-2029, p. 16
goals.description: Promote NC agriculture and agribusiness by creating positive entertainment and educational experiences and fostering economic opportunities.
objectives: Promote NC agriculture and agribusiness by creating positive entertainment and educational experiences and fostering economic opportunities.

goals.title: Administrative services
goals.citation: NC Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services Strategic Plan 2025-2029, p. 19
goals.description: Provide services and support that help the Department achieve its mission.
objectives: 5.1 Increase the percentage of capital improvement projects completed on time, on budget, and meeting the needs of the end user
